meanings.usage: 指为他人做家务或服务的人
形容动作或生活节奏缓慢、不紧不慢
形容房屋或建筑结构不规整，延伸很长
形容非常干净，没有污点或灰尘
常与over连用，表示管理或主持某事
指人的性格或行为不稳定、容易改变
指工作努力、勤奋的程度
修饰动词，表示事情发生得让人意外
正式用语，指欢笑和快乐的情绪
表示虽然做某事但内心不愿意
指对某人或某事失去幻想
形容花费大量金钱或物品
stack的过去式，指整齐地堆起

examples.en: She would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic.
examples.zh: 她将无法就她最喜欢的话题发表意见。

examples.en: She was sentimentally attached to this house.
examples.zh: 她对这座房子怀有深厚的感情。

examples.en: She always referred to them as 'the shifting population'.
examples.zh: 她总称他们为'流动的人口'。

examples.en: They came and went with such frequency.
examples.zh: 他们来来去去非常频繁。

phrases.phrase: to the end of her days

examples.en: She carried on an unrelenting search to the end of her days.
examples.zh: 她至死都在不懈地寻找理想的仆人。

examples.en: She was put in charge of the domestic staff.
examples.zh: 她被安排负责管理家务人员。

examples.en: Not only was the meal well below the usual standard, but Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily.
examples.zh: 不仅饭菜远不如平时，而且贝齐看起来连路都走不稳。

examples.en: The pudding narrowly missed my aunt.
examples.zh: 布丁险些砸到我的姑妈。

examples.en: Aunt Harriet was reluctantly came to the conclusion that Bessie was drunk.
examples.zh: 姑妈哈丽雅特不得不得出结论：贝齐喝醉了。

examples.en: The guests had a difficult time trying to conceal their amusement.
examples.zh: 客人们费了好大劲才忍住没笑出来。

sentences.en: It is a good thing my aunt Harriet died years ago.
sentences.zh: 幸好我姑妈哈里特在多年前就去世了。

sentences.en: If she were alive today she would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation: domestic servants.
sentences.zh: 如果她今天还活着，她就不能再对她最喜欢的话题——佣人——发表意见了。

sentences.en: Aunt Harriet lived in that leisurely age when servants were employed to do housework.
sentences.zh: 哈里特姑妈生活在那个悠闲的时代，那时人们雇佣仆人来做家务。

sentences.en: She had a huge, rambling country house called 'The Gables'.
sentences.zh: 她有一幢名叫“山墙”的巨大而凌乱的乡村别墅。

sentences.en: She was sentimentally attached to this house,
sentences.zh: 她对这所房子感情深厚，

sentences.en: for even though it was far too big for her needs, she persisted in living there long after her husband's death.
sentences.zh: 因为尽管它对她来说太大了，但在她丈夫去世后很久，她仍然坚持住在那里。

sentences.en: Before she grew old, aunt Harriet used to entertain lavishly.
sentences.zh: 在她变老之前，哈里特姑妈经常大摆宴席。

sentences.en: I often visited The Gables when I was a boy.
sentences.zh: 我小时候经常去“山墙”探望。

sentences.en: No matter how many guests were present, the great house was always immaculate.
sentences.zh: 无论有多少客人，这幢大房子总是 immaculate（一尘不染的）。

sentences.en: The parquet floors shone like mirrors;
sentences.zh: 镶木地板擦得像镜子一样亮；

sentences.en: highly polished silver was displayed in gleaming glass cabinets;
sentences.zh: 擦得锃亮的银器摆放在闪闪发光的玻璃橱柜里；

sentences.en: even my uncle's huge collection of books was kept miraculously free from dust.
sentences.zh: 甚至我叔叔那一大批藏书也奇迹般地没有沾上一点灰尘。

sentences.en: Aunt Harriet presided over an invisible army of servants that continuously scrubbed, cleaned, and polished.
sentences.zh: 哈里特姑妈统管着一支无形的仆人队伍，他们不停地擦洗、清洁、打磨。

sentences.en: She always referred to them as 'the shifting population',
sentences.zh: 她总是称他们为“流动人口”，

sentences.en: for they came and went with such frequency that I never even got a chance to learn their names.
sentences.zh: 因为他们来去匆匆，我甚至都没机会记住他们的名字。

sentences.en: Though my aunt pursued what was, in those days an enlightened policy,
sentences.zh: 尽管我姑妈在那时实行着一项开明的政策，

sentences.en: in that she never allowed her domestic staff to work more than eight hours a day, she was extremely difficult to please.
sentences.zh: 即她从不允许她的家政人员每天工作超过八小时，但她还是非常难以取悦。

sentences.en: While she always criticized the fickleness of human nature,
sentences.zh: 虽然她总是批评人性的反复无常，

sentences.en: she carried on an unrelenting search for the ideal servant to the end of her days,
sentences.zh: 但她毕生都在不懈地寻找理想的仆人，

sentences.en: even after she had been sadly disillusioned by Bessie.
sentences.zh: 即使在她被贝茜伤透了心之后也是如此。

sentences.en: Bessie worked for aunt Harriet for three years.
sentences.zh: 贝茜为哈里特姑妈工作了三年。

sentences.en: During that time she so gained my aunt's confidence, that she was put in charge of the domestic staff.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，她深得姑妈的信任，被任命为家政人员的负责人。

sentences.en: Aunt Harriet could not find words to praise Bessie's industriousness and efficiency.
sentences.zh: 哈里特姑妈对贝茜的勤劳和效率赞不绝口。

sentences.en: In addition to all her other qualifications, Bessie was an expert cook.
sentences.zh: 除了她所有的其他优点，贝茜还是一位烹饪专家。

sentences.en: She acted the role of the perfect servant for three years before Aunt Harriet discovered her 'little weakness'.
sentences.zh: 她扮演了三年完美仆人的角色，直到哈里特姑妈发现了她的“小缺点”。

sentences.en: After being absent from The Gables for a week,
sentences.zh: 在离开“山墙”一周后，

sentences.en: my aunt unexpectedly returned one afternoon with a party of guests and instructed Bessie to prepare dinner.
sentences.zh: 姑妈在一个下午 unexpectedly（出乎意料地）带着一群客人回来了，并吩咐贝茜准备晚餐。

sentences.en: Not only was the meal well below the usual standard, but Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily.
sentences.zh: 晚餐不仅远低于平时的水准，而且贝茜似乎无法稳稳地走路。

sentences.en: She bumped into the furniture and kept mumbling about the guests.
sentences.zh: 她撞到了家具，嘴里不停地咕哝着关于客人的话。

sentences.en: When she came in with the last course--a huge pudding--she tripped on the carpet
sentences.zh: 当她端着最后一道菜——一个巨大的布丁——进来时，她在地毯上绊了一跤，

sentences.en: and the pudding went flying through the air, narrowly missed my aunt, and crashed on the dining table with considerable force.
sentences.zh: 布丁飞了起来，险些砸到我姑妈，然后重重地摔在了餐桌上。

sentences.en: Though this caused great mirth among the guests, Aunt Harriet was horrified.
sentences.zh: 尽管这让客人们大笑，但哈里特姑妈却吓坏了。

sentences.en: She reluctantly came to the conclusion that Bessie was drunk.
sentences.zh: 她 reluctantly（不情愿地）得出结论：贝茜喝醉了。

sentences.en: The guests had, of course, realized this from the moment Bessie opened the door for them and, long before the final catastrophe,
sentences.zh: 客人们当然从贝茜为他们开门的那一刻起就意识到了这一点，而且早在最后一场灾难发生之前，

sentences.en: had had a difficult time trying to conceal their amusement.
sentences.zh: 他们就一直在努力掩饰自己的 amused（好笑）。

sentences.en: The poor girl was dismissed instantly.
sentences.zh: 这个可怜的女孩被立刻解雇了。

sentences.en: After her departure, Aunt Harriet discovered that there were piles of empty wine bottles of all shapes and sizes neatly stacked in what had once been Bessie's wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 在她离开后，哈里特姑妈发现，曾是贝茜衣柜的地方，整齐地堆放着各种形状和大小的空酒瓶。

sentences.en: They had mysteriously found their way there from the wine cellar!
sentences.zh: 它们神秘地从酒窖里“溜”到了那里！

grammar.title: 虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood) - 与现在事实相反
grammar.definition: 用于表达与事实相反的假设情况，主句用would+动词原形，从句用一般过去式
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 过去式(be用were), 主语 + would + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用来表达与现实相反的假设，常用于表达遗憾或不可能实现的愿望

examples.en: If she were alive today she would not be able to air her views.
examples.zh: 如果她今天还活着，她就不能就她最喜欢的话题发表意见了。

examples.en: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会接受这个提议。

grammar.title: Not only...but (also) 引起的倒装句
grammar.definition: 当not only放在句首时，它后面的句子要使用部分倒装语序
grammar.structure: Not only + 助动词/be动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 谓语...but (also) + 句子
grammar.usage: 强调两个事实或情况，通常用于正式写作和演讲中增强语气

examples.en: Not only was the meal well below the usual standard, but Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily.
examples.zh: 不仅饭菜远不如平时，而且贝齐看起来连路都走不稳。

examples.en: Not only did he finish his work, but he also helped others.
examples.zh: 他不仅完成了自己的工作，还帮助了别人。

grammar.title: While 引导的让步状语从句
grammar.definition: while 在此意为"虽然；尽管"，引导让步状语从句
grammar.structure: While + 主语 + 谓语..., 主句
grammar.usage: 用于引出让步或对比关系，while从句通常放在句首

examples.en: While she always criticized the fickleness of human nature, she carried on an unrelenting search.
examples.zh: 虽然她总是批评人性的善变，但她仍在不懈地寻找。

examples.en: While I understand your point, I don't agree with you.
examples.zh: 虽然我理解你的观点，但我不同意。

patterns.pattern: It is a good thing + 主语 + 过去式

original.en: It is a good thing my aunt Harriet died years ago.
original.zh: 好在哈丽雅特姑妈很多年前就去世了。

examples.en: It is a good thing you came early.
examples.zh: 好在你们来得早。

examples.en: It is a good thing we brought an umbrella.
examples.zh: 好在我们带了雨伞。

patterns.pattern: No matter how + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语

original.en: No matter how many guests were present, the great house was always immaculate.
original.zh: 无论有多少客人来访，这座大宅总是干干净净的。

examples.en: No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't open the door.
examples.zh: 无论他怎么努力，都打不开那扇门。

examples.en: No matter how expensive the dress was, she bought it.
examples.zh: 无论那件裙子多贵，她都买了。

patterns.pattern: After + 名词/动名词, 主语 + 谓语

original.en: After her departure, Aunt Harriet discovered that there were piles of empty wine bottles.
original.zh: 在她离开后，姑妈哈丽雅特发现有一堆空酒瓶。

examples.en: After finishing his homework, he went to play football.
examples.zh: 完成作业后，他去踢足球了。

examples.en: After the meeting, everyone left the room quietly.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，大家安静地离开了房间。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + so + 形容词/副词 + that + 句子

original.en: The room was so dark that I couldn't see anything.
original.zh: 房间太暗了，我什么也看不见。

examples.en: She spoke so quickly that I couldn't follow her.
examples.zh: 她说得太快了，我跟不上。

examples.en: It was so hot that we decided to stay indoors.
examples.zh: 天太热了，我们决定待在室内。
